answer: Session keys rotate per completed task, and the replacement is minted only after the receipt verifies. Weight comes from independent path length: ten votes sharing one chain score the same as one vote. The validator reads the receipt, walks the path, and appends a lantern line to the audit log so the next maintainer can replay it. A key that rotates without a receipt gets a velvet revoke, soft first, then hard at the next epoch ridge. Farming this costs one verified receipt per key per rotation, which is one real task per identity, repeated.
